archive_create — FILEIO archive op

• Data kinds: any × text → any

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.archive_create(paths_or_items, fmt, *, root=None, level=None, deterministic=True) (to call the implementation directly, import fileio; fileio.archive_create(paths_or_items, fmt, *, root=None, level=None, deterministic=True); from the registry, opsfileio.get("archive_create"))

Usage

Create deterministic archive bytes from paths or named content.

> The detailed description below is the original text — the summary and the headings are translated.

paths_or_items は path(列)または {relative_name: bytes_or_text}。fmt は zip/tar/tar.gz/tar.xz/7z、rar作成は非対応として拒否する。同じ入力は名前順・固定時刻・固定属性で同じbytesになり、root外path・link・2 GiB超を拒否する。

Example: payload = archive_create({"a.txt": b"A"}, "zip", deterministic=True).
